#
# QuarziteOS Kernel (qzkrnl) -- a from-scratch NT-style kernel.
#
# It is built next to ntoskrnl.exe and booted by FreeLoader with
# "/KERNEL=qzkrnl.exe" (see the "QuarziteOS Kernel" boot menu entries).
# qzkrnl.spec is generated by tools/genspec.py from ntoskrnl.spec and
# exports.spec -- re-run it whenever either changes.
#

if(NOT ARCH STREQUAL "i386")
    message(STATUS "qzkrnl: only i386 is supported for now, skipping")
    return()
endif()

if(NOT (CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang"))
    message(STATUS "qzkrnl: requires GCC or Clang (GNU inline assembly), skipping")
    return()
endif()

spec2def(qzkrnl.exe qzkrnl.spec)

list(APPEND SOURCE
    ex/init.c
    ex/shell.c
    ex/version.c
    ke/bugcheck.c
    ke/irq.c
    ke/irql.c
    ke/sched.c
    ke/synctest.c
    ke/timerobj.c
    ke/wait.c
    ke/i386/cpu.c
    ke/i386/trap.c
    mm/mm.c
    mm/pool.c
    drv/input.c
    drv/kbd.c
    drv/rtc.c
    drv/serial.c
    drv/vga.c
    rtl/print.c
    rtl/rtl.c
    rtl/time.c)

add_executable(qzkrnl
    ${SOURCE}
    qzkrnl.rc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qzkrnl_stubs.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qzkrnl.def)

target_include_directories(qzkrnl PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_compile_definitions(qzkrnl PRIVATE _NTSYSTEM_ _NTOSKRNL_ __QZKRNL__)
target_compile_options(qzkrnl PRIVATE -fno-builtin)
set_module_type(qzkrnl kernel)
add_dependencies(qzkrnl psdk bugcodes)

add_cd_file(TARGET qzkrnl DESTINATION reactos/system32 NO_CAB FOR all)
